notes.title: Dev Update #10 - The Council
notes.content:
[h2]Add us to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944560

Hi everyone!

We've been a little quieter here for the last few weeks while we worked hard on releasing on other game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130]The Seven Realms: High Lathión[/url][/b].

Going forward, we'll post to this page every two to three weeks with new updates to ensure the updates stay fresh. As we approach release, we'll start posting more frequently, when we have more of the game in its final form to share with you all!

For today, we thought we'd share some information about the world, and one of the major plot points of A College of Thirst & Claws:

[i]Several hundred years ago, Earth was in chaos.

Vampires turned humans into their vampire-spawn at will. If the turned-vampire was strong, only their sire (the one who turned them), or someone considerably stronger, could control them.

Humans, catching wind of this, began hunting vampires. While humans posed no real threat to vampires, it benefitted nobody to kill humans in the masses.

The Vampire Council determined that vampires could no longer turn humans without specific approval from the council themselves.

Anyone who disobeyed this would be executed, along with the newly turned vampire.

So, if a friend of yours is turned without council approval, to what lengths will you go to protect them?[/i]

notes.title: Dev Update #9 - Our Progress So Far
notes.content:
[h2]Add us to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944560

Hey everyone! Last week, we said we'd update you on the game's overall development progress.

Season 1 will consist of five episodes. We currently plan to release all of these together at launch.
[h1]Where are we at?[/h1]
Firstly, there's still a long way to go until we can release; however, we're progressing steadily.

[u][h2]Still Images[/h2][/u]
We've posed all of the still images for Season 1. This is currently slightly under 10,000 images.

They are still a long way from their final forms, though. We need to enhance some of the environments by improving the textures, and we'll also need to repose some images after testing.

Once we've approved all images in their final poses, we'll need to light, render and complete post-work on them.

We are still a long way off finalising them, but the fact that we have these images posed is an exciting milestone for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/3d0d4a5748c054d389bcedafb12e920215b23608.jpg[/img]
[u][h2]Testing[/h2][/u]
We've started play-testing the game's first episode with our work-in-progress images.

This exercise has been helpful so far. We're ensuring that the images match the dialogue, changing character poses where necessary, adjusting dialogue to flow better, and expanding it in some parts.

The testing is still in the early stages, but like with the still images, it's exciting to be at this stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/66acf512f50e16c274e5e72c149db96f9465869f.png[/img]
[u][h2]Animations[/h2][/u]
We've now animated all "safe-for-work" animations planned for Season 1. During testing, we're mapping out places where we could add more, so we may do so as development continues.

There are currently 23 of these animations. They still need additional work, such as texturing, lighting, rendering, post-work, and sounds added.

We're also making significant progress with the "not-safe-for-work" animations. Of the 62 planned, we only have nine left to animate. Again, these numbers may change, but this is where we're at in our current plan. Additional work is needed on these until they reach their final form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/08e650b3d67b589eaa664c2159db528ea97d8310.gif[/img]
[u][h2]User Interface[/h2][/u]
While we've implemented the first version of the game's interface, we know there is still room for improvement. We've not worked on this recently, but as we approach the launch, we will make some big changes to ensure it works seamlessly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/c2537297d2e63291f6b09cf49b2cf95fa210094d.png[/img]
[u][h2]Overall[/h2][/u]
We've done a lot of work on this, but there is very little in its final form. Once we begin lighting and rendering the images and animations, we'll have many more graphics to share on these posts. We're excited for that!

We're still waiting to commit to a release date, but our internal aim for Season 1's release is Spring 2025.

We hope this provided you with some insight into the game's development. If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment!

Have a great weekend :)

notes.title: Dev Update #6 - Supernatural Ladies
notes.content:
[h2]Add us to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944560

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2944560/view/4659626075692811461]We previously discussed three of the main species that will feature in ACTC.[/url]

While the realms are home to many species, two more will feature prominently in ACTC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/9bf2e51d5f8d3694322aa2171b101bd820a2315c.gif[/img]
[h1]Mermaids[/h1]
Merpeople live underwater. They typically have large fish-like tails and appear human from the waist up.

When on land, they can shift their bottom half and use human legs.

They are naturally an emotional species and try to avoid conflict. Their siren songs can enchant less powerful beings, making them very dangerous.

Their lifespan is similar to that of a human.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/5a5be26f3c0c4f65b9b825c69acccea16f8e8b23.jpg[/img]
[h1]Witches[/h1]
Witches are an ambitious species. Most reside in Pythonium, but many of their population make their home in other realms.

Physically, they look the same as humans. The main difference is their magical abilities. Witches specialise in various fields of magic. They are most well-renowned for their unique understanding of ancient spells and curses.

Having always shared a realm with demons who have heavily oppressed them, they have a bitter rivalry with one another.

Their lifespan varies drastically. Those with lesser magical talent live around as long as humans do. For powerful witches or those who have used spells to prolong their lives, they can live for thousands of years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/ed6f1f21916280e31a4b6bf5c24363699d665a52.jpg[/img]

Follow us and wishlist to keep updated!

notes.title: Dev Update #3 - Who You'll Meet In Lanstone
notes.content:
[h2]Add us to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944560

[b]ACTC[/b] takes place in an American college, but is set in a universe with numerous other "realms" with a range of unique species.

Today, we'll share some details of those native to Lanstone.

[i](We'll warm you up with an work-in-progress animation of a human woman taking a shower)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/13fbe0d1cdd869170b4b8b8a116aba12e79864c1.gif[/img]
[h1]Humans[/h1]
Humans are the most prominent species.

Most are oblivious to the existence of other supernatural species and realms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/6919481f0bf353c4990a5c2ba67d71a9e39f88a5.jpg[/img]
[h1]Vampires[/h1]
Vampires are the most ancient species living on Terran.

They often look the same as humans, except for their sharp fangs, which they use to drink blood.

Weak vampires must feed regularly; however, strong ones can feed infrequently.

They've been ruling over the werewolves of Terran for millennia, causing either awe or resentment among them.

They are known for their cold and calculated ways of looking at problems and lack of exclusivity in romantic relationships.

Vampires can either be Born or Turned. Born vampires are the children of two powerful vampires. Turned vampires are members of other species who have been turned into vampires by another vampire.

It is complicated for vampires to conceive children, often taking them hundreds or thousands of years to do so successfully.

Vampires are immortal and will not die of old age. There are extremely few ways to kill them. Some vampires decide to die voluntarily by going to slumber.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/ebdbf1e313581ce0046c3ef49aa2f1b8b0614303.jpg[/img]
[h1]Werewolves[/h1]
Werewolves can usually shapeshift at will and have both a wolf and a human form. Even in their human form, they have exceptional physical strength. They are often hot-blooded and will act before thinking things through.

Wolves almost always stick together in packs. They have a caste system within their society, where their strength dictates their position within the pack.

Alpha's are the pack leaders, and Luna's are their bond/soul mates. Beta's are the second in command. Omega's are the weakest pack members, who complete fewer physical activities, and the stronger pack members protect them.

A legend states that the Moon Goddess created them, and many werewolves worship her.

They have always been ruled and governed by vampires. Some werewolves have no issue with this, but many resent the vampires and feel they oppress wolves.

The average lifespan of a werewolf is around 150 years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/0ae805f06753dbc62c3b7ecbfaf4e69749a91601.jpg[/img]
Stick around for information on other species you will encounter in ACTC in a future post!

Lanstone Mountain College operates a program for non-human species to integrate into human life. However, humans remain oblivious to the existence of supernatural beings.

After spending your whole life in a secluded werewolf pack, you have recently enrolled in this program.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/b1e8e36de2753724d487b5eac0dfd11f22d880db.jpg[/img]
Alongside humans, your story will connect you with vampires, werewolves, mermaids, and witches.

Thankfully, the head of this program, [i][b]Ilona[/b][/i], is helping you through the process!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/a160523f737f2df0d0932698503743b62ec2f8e0.jpg[/img]
[b]ACTC[/b] is set in the same world as [b]The Seven Realms [i](TSR)[/i][/b], another game we are developing.

If you've played or plan to play [b]TSR[/b] before jumping into [b]ACTC[/b], you may find a few references and easter eggs sprinkled throughout.

However, no prior knowledge is needed before starting [b]ACTC[/b], as while they take place in the same world, the stories are self-contained and follow different groups of characters.

We hope this offers you a little more insight into the setting. If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment!

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - What to Expect & New Previews!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!

It's been a little while since we posted any updates on the development of [b]ACTC[/b]. We've been working hard in the background and have made tremendous progress.

Very little is in its "final form" right now, so we've not shared much. However, we're eager to share what we're up to, so we plan to release weekly updates moving forward. These will highlight development progress, character details, lore information, and other news.

In this post, we'll share some rough numbers with you to show the scope of this first season and some work-in-progress animations and images.

[b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944560/A_College_of_Thirst__Claws__Season_1/"]ACTC - Season 1[/url][/b] will consist of [b]five episodes[/b]. When we launch Season 1, all five episodes will be present.

In terms of numbers, the season will consist of roughly 10,000 still images and 200 animations.

We have already posed most of the images and animated numerous animations. However, we still need to light and render the images and animations before finalising them.

[b]Most of the images shared in this post are a work in progress and do not represent what will appear in the finished game at launch.[/b]  We have included a couple of the final images from our store page to show you the quality we aim for with all the work-in-progress pieces. notes.title: Introducing: A College of Thirst & Claws
notes.content:
[h3][b]A College of Thirst & Claws[/b] [i][b](ACTC)[/b][/i] is an immersive, story-driven adult visual novel.[/h3]

[h3][i]Forge meaningful connections with beautiful women as you shape your own story.
[/i][/h3]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944560/A_College_of_Thirst__Claws__Season_1/]Thanks for checking out our Steam page![/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/12330316520b35612b541530aab182dcd3620489.jpg[/img]
You and your twin sister, Mika, spent your lives in a werewolf pack, where your father is the Alpha. He harbours a deep hatred towards you and isolates you from the outside world.

When your father abruptly forces you to leave your pack and attend a unique college where supernatural beings mingle with humans, it's a chance for a fresh start in a place unlike any you've known.

However, after making a dangerous decision, you've found yourself in a sinister plot far beyond anything you anticipated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/6919481f0bf353c4990a5c2ba67d71a9e39f88a5.jpg[/img]
[b]ACTC[/b] consists of seven main love interests. 

You can expect numerous high-quality sex scenes throughout the story, as well as stunning cinematics, to give you an even more immersive experience.

Your play style will have a direct impact on the sex scenes. Will you lean into your Alpha werewolf side and dominate, or will you come with a gentler approach?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/b3b83e4f0c0cca7d3780467c38d45188aa0ed55a.gif[/img]

We will reveal more about our love interests as we approach the game's release and share some previews of these sex scenes in action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/2c09a4616ec13693c94dec4786c31f18f0af4ae8.jpg[/img]
[i][b]What else can you expect?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] A character-driven story shaped by your choices.
[*] Over 10,000 gorgeous images.
[*] Detailed cinematics to enhance your experience.
[*] A range of voice-acted sex scenes that will vary depending on your playstyle.
[*] An evolving glossary to help you keep track of the characters and lore.
[*] Original music and sound effects, designed for the story.
[*] A sex scene replay gallery and image favouriting to revisit memorable moments.
